{{Quote|He was at Qarshan's game a few years back when Nintellor made that famous bet where he put half his collection on the table.|[[Tavia Kitik]], on [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Winner Lose All">''[[Winner Lose All]]''</ref>}}
'''Nintellor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] who was active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He owned a rare [[Tchine]] statue and several other valuable items, and on one occasion, in a bet that would later become famous, Nintellor staked his Tchine and half of his collection while participating in a gambling tournament held by [[Qarshan]]. He was subsequently able to win his Tchine back.
